result.title: ShiftCache: Fast and Exact Indel Effect Prediction by Reusing Shifted Reference Encodings
result.summary: Sequence-to-function models such as AlphaGenome and Borzoi read up to a megabase of DNA and score a genetic variant by comparing their predictions for the reference and alternate sequences. Insertions and deletions (indels) are costly to score, because an indel usually shifts the unchanged DNA after it onto a different pooling grid, which prevents direct reuse of the reference's encoder activations. The AlphaGenome Atlas scored more than 100 million indels with three full model passes each, although the DNA after an indel matches the reference shifted by the indel's length. We present ShiftCache, an exact reuse system that encodes each shifted reference once and shares it among all variants scored in the same window with the same shift. ShiftCache copies every encoder output a variant can reuse and recomputes the rest in batched tiles. On held-out AlphaGenome windows shared by many indels, in strict fp32 on one A6000, ShiftCache is 3.5 to 6.5$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution and 1.6 to 2.7$\times$ faster than our adaptation of layer-by-layer reuse to indels. It is 3.5 to 4.1$\times$ faster than dense reimplementations of two published analyses with Borzoi and AlphaGenome, and 2.6$\times$ faster than dense execution with Enformer. Scoring each variant in its own centered 131 kb window makes ShiftCache only 1.36$\times$ faster than deduplicated dense execution, and highly diverse insertion lengths or many dispersed edits can make it slower than layer-by-layer reuse or dense execution. For encoders that meet our conditions, ShiftCache computes the same predictions as dense execution in exact arithmetic. On an A6000, every checked output of the default AlphaGenome and Borzoi runs matches dense execution within an absolute and relative tolerance of $10^{-5}$. With larger tile batches, with Enformer or on an H100, a small fraction of values exceeds this tolerance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ShiftCache，针对 AlphaGenome、Borzoi 等 DNA 序列到功能模型，把 indel 变异后与参考序列相同、只是整体位移的片段所对应的编码器激活复用起来，其余部分按批分块重算，从而在保证与稠密执行一致的前提下加速变异打分。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「输入局部改动、其余部分平移」时精确复用中间激活并按块补齐的思路，可能为 LVR 中新增视觉证据或滑动窗口时增量更新 latent 状态、避免全量重编码提供可供核查的工程线索，但复用条件与容差表现需结合原文确认。
